description: This header file declares the exported API functions for the HTTP Simple Message Parser (SMP), including functions for creating, removing, initializing, and decoding URLs within the parser.

methods.name: CreateHttpSmpo
methods.description: Creates an instance of the HTTP SMP object with provided context handles.

methods.name: HttpSmpoCreate
methods.description: Constructs a new HTTP SMP object with specified context handles.

methods.name: HttpSmpoRemove
methods.description: Removes and cleans up the specified HTTP SMP object.

methods.name: HttpSmpoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls or registers required objects within the HTTP SMP context.

methods.name: HttpSmpoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the HTTP SMP object, preparing it for operation.

methods.name: HttpSmpoDecodeUrl
methods.description: Decodes an URL string into its decoded form, given the input string and output buffers.
